s.note: Owen building his cabin by hand
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions slowly with a spoon of brown sugar for 30 minutes until jammy. Grill 8 thick beef sausages over coals until blistered and cooked through. Slice thickly, spear on toothpicks and serve with the onions and wholegrain mustard.

s.note: the secret cloning lab under Lockwood Manor
s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel. Wrap each in about 80g sausage meat, 500g in total, roll in flour, 1 beaten egg and breadcrumbs. Deep fry at 170C for 6 minutes, or bake at 200C for 25 minutes, then halve to serve.

m.n: Isla Nublar chilli lime chicken and beans
m.note: the rescue team heading back into the island jungle
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thigh fillets in the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped red chilli, 2 tbsp oil and salt for 1 hour. Grill over high heat for 5 minutes a side until charred. Cook 300g rice. Warm 2 drained cans black beans with 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp smoked paprika. Dice 3 tomatoes with half a red onion and coriander. Serve the chicken over rice and beans with the salsa.

w.note: Owen living rough while he builds his cabin
w.how: Slit 4 bananas lengthways through the top skin without cutting through the bottom, and open them slightly. Stuff each with 25g chopped dark chocolate and a handful of mini marshmallows from 50g. Wrap each in foil and cook on a barbecue or at 200C in the oven for 10 minutes until melted. Open the foil, scatter with 4 crushed digestive biscuits and eat with spoons.

d.how: Steep 2 tbsp dried butterfly pea flowers in 500ml boiling water for 10 minutes, strain, stir in 3 tbsp honey and chill. Fill 4 glasses with crushed ice and pour in the blue tea until half full. Top each with lemonade. Serve with lime wedges on the side and let everyone squeeze in the lime to watch the colour change.
